solution_summary: GOL Linhas Aéreas built this solution on Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Logic Apps, Power BI. In recent years, the company has been undergoing a digital transformation, modernizing its structure and operations – with the goal of doing more with less. In this process, Gol began to review and reorganize its data solutions to meet new demands. Azure Data Factory moves and orchestrates data from source systems into the analytics platform. Azure Databricks processes, transforms, and engineers large data sets for analytics and machine learning. Azure Logic Apps automates cross-system workflows and security or business process integrations. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. The airline’s Data & Analytics team has built an environment that orchestrates the collection of data from multiple sources into a single, Azure-based data lake.
